messages:
Nina: Quick thread — finalizing HelioSoft case story + webinar routing. Need: quote approval, demo timing in the webinar, and leads sent to helio-ae queue. See brief: https://redwood.docs/heliosoft-case-brief :spiral_calendar:
Jorge: I'll lock interview times. Who from Helio do we want? CTO + Product Ops? And a short product clip?
Nina: CTO for systems impact, Product Ops for outcomes. 5-min demo after first panel. Also need clear consent on reg form for recording + follow-up.
Priya: Drafted pull quote: "Switching to Redwood cut our inference costs and sped up delivery." Would prefer more specific if Helio will confirm numbers. Tagged possible percent lines with [LEGAL].
Aaron: Legal prefers not to publish exact percentages unless there's an email confirmation. Suggest: "noticeable inference cost reductions" unless Helio signs a percent. If they want a transcript NDA, ping me.
reg-bot: registration form updated: consent checkbox added. Webhook mapped to SFDC campaign Helio-Q2-Launch.
Jorge: Sent Doodle with three slots. Also asked Helio for OK to record and for an explicit percent if they want it included.
Priya: Sent quote to Helio for redline. Also prepared two short cutdowns (30s/60s) for promo. If they request redactions we may need +48-72 hours.
Nina: Routing note: during live webinar, leads go to queue helio-ae and tag source=webinar. Aaron, please confirm SFDC assignment rules won't overwrite existing owners.
Aaron: Confirmed. I'll add a rule to prefer queue assignment when source=webinar. Testing in staging now.
Nina: TL;DR: Interviews pending, legal looped, reg form consent done, SFDC routing to helio-ae, embargo target May 18. Check-in tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
